notes.title: The DEMO is coming for Steam Next Fest October 2023!
notes.content:
Get ready for an epic goblin invasion at Steam Next Fest!

It's time to put your spears and arrows to the test because Age of Goblins is about to storm Steam Next Fest in October 2023! Our small (but terribly mischievous) friends are eager to emerge from the shadows and invade your PC for the first time.

Don't miss the opportunity to try it out!
We're excited to announce that starting from the next Steam Next Fest, you'll be able to test Age of Goblins with a free demo! We intend to keep the demo available indefinitely, so don't miss the chance, as we don't know when we'll have to remove it.

We want to hear from you!
Enjoy yourselves to your heart's content and then share with us in the Community section what you thought of the experience. We want to hear your feedback and implement improvements.

See you soon!
We hope to see you at Steam Next Fest!
And as the goblin leader Rkhan'Rhun would say: "- Rhakrtai rhatkaan, rhan!" (um, but I never really understood what that means...)
